english.title: Fail to display registered name continuously in visible manner
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were

(A)_[a company which,]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), who was in default, the company having,]_

without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement that its registered name, at an office, place or location shared by no more than five companies, was

(C)_[so positioned that it may be easily seen by any visitor to that office, place or location]_
(D)_[displayed continuously]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(2) and 28 of the Company, Limited Liability Partnership and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015.
